children: Bitcoin application layer Citrea said cross-chain transfers for ctUSD, USDC, USDT, WBTC, and CTR have been restored after review. According to Foresight News, solver-based routes such as ctUSD and USDC swaps are being rolled out gradually, while full recovery may take longer.

The Zentra team has identified the root cause and paused its contracts to contain the incident. Citrea said its own protocol and bridge contracts were not affected. It also said it will issue another statement to assess the impact of the third-party security incident on the ecosystem, including ctUSD Earn Vault and follow-up arrangements for affected depositors.
Citrea previously said it had suspended cross-chain functions for ctUSD, USDC, USDT, WBTC, and CTR as a precaution after a security incident at third-party application Zentra Finance.

title: Citrea Restores Cross-Chain Transfers for ctUSD, USDC, USDT, WBTC, and CTR
